20261121-chemistry-g04-2.title: Ndeupi musiyano uri pakati pe‘kuvhuvhuta’
20261121-chemistry-g04-2.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Ndeupi musiyano uri pakati pe‘kuvhuvhuta’ kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261121-chemistry-g04-2.material: Ndeupi musiyano uri pakati pe‘kuvhuvhuta’ ne‘kuvira’ kunoitika kana mvura ichidziiswa mupoto?
20261121-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.prompt: Ndeupi musiyano uri pakati pe‘kuvhuvhuta’ ne‘kuvira’ kunoitika kana mvura ichidziiswa mupoto?
20261121-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.explain: Kuvhuvhuta ndiko mvura inoshanduka kuita gasi patembiricha iri pasi pekuvira pamusoro pemvura, uye kuvira ndiko kuvhuvhuta kunoitika zvakanyanya nepamusoro napakati pemvura yose kana yasvika pakuvira.
20261121-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.hint.0: Kuomarara kwenguvo kunoitika kuvhuvhuta kunononoka pamusoro patembiricha yakaderera.
20261121-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.hint.1: Kuvira zvakanyanya kwemvura ndiko kuvira apo mabhubhu anopasuka mukati patembiricha ye100 degrees.
20261121-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.o.o0: Kuvhuvhuta kunoitika pamusoro pemvura chete, uye kuvira kunoitika pakuvira (100℃) apo mabhubhu anoumbwa pamusoro napakati pemvura yose
20261121-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.o.o1: Kuvhuvhuta kunoitika pa100℃ chete, uye kuvira kunoitika patembiricha dzose
20261121-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.o.o2: Kuvhuvhuta ndiko mvura kuita echine, uye kuvira ndiko kuita mhute

20261122-chemistry-g04-1.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Shanduko yemamiriro ezvinhu yepamusoro kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-chemistry-g04-1.material: [Shanduko yemamiriro ezvinhu yepamusoro] Mvura iri mubheka yakadziiswa ikatanga kuvira zvakanyanya. Kunyangwe ukawedzera simba remoto ukaramba uchipisa, ndechipi chikonzero chekuti mutsara wethermometer usingakwire pamusoro pe100℃?
20261122-chemistry-g04-1.s.s1.prompt: [Shanduko yemamiriro ezvinhu yepamusoro] Mvura iri mubheka yakadziiswa ikatanga kuvira zvakanyanya. Kunyangwe ukawedzera simba remoto ukaramba uchipisa, ndechipi chikonzero chekuti mutsara wethermometer usingakwire pamusoro pe100℃?
20261122-chemistry-g04-1.s.s1.explain: Panguva iyo mvura yakachena ichivira, simba rekupisa rinoshandiswa rose pakutyora simba rekukwevera pakati pemamorekuru nekuashandura kuita gasi (kupisa kwekuvira), saka tembiricha inogara yakafanana kusvika mvura yose yashanduka kuita mhute.

20261122-chemistry-g04-1.s.s1.hint.1: Izvi zvinonzi ‘kupisa kwakavanzika (latent heat, kupisa kwekuvira)’.

20261122-chemistry-g04-2.title: Sarudza kuroverwa kwakarurama
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Sarudza kuroverwa kwakarurama kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.material: Chii chinoratidzwa nenzira kwayo yemamiriro ezvinhu e‘dew’ yakajeka inoumbwa pamashizha mangwanani, uye ‘frost’ chena inoumbwa pawindo nepadenga usiku hwekupera kwerudo? Sarudza kuroverwa kwakarurama.
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.prompt: Chii chinoratidzwa nenzira kwayo yemamiriro ezvinhu e‘dew’ yakajeka inoumbwa pamashizha mangwanani, uye ‘frost’ chena inoumbwa pawindo nepadenga usiku hwekupera kwerudo? Sarudza kuroverwa kwakarurama.
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.explain: Dew mhute iri mumhepo inoshanduka kuita mvura (condensation) pamusoro pemashizha anotonhora usiku, uye frost mhute inoshanduka zvakananga kuita makristasi echine pasina kupfuura nemvura patembiricha iri pasi pezero.
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.hint.1: Frost makristasi echine anoumbwa patembiricha iri pasi pezero (mhute → chakasimba).
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.o.o0: Dew: mhute inoshanduka kuita matinji emvura (condensation) / frost: mhute inoshanduka zvakananga kuita makristasi echine (sublimation yekudzoka)
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.o.o1: Dew: echine rinonyungudika (melting) / frost: mvura inovira (vaporization)
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.o.o2: Dew nefrost zvose mvura yakavhuvhuta ikaita mhute
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.o.o3: Dew: mvura yechitubu inobuda pasi / frost: chando chinobva kudenga
